dataset.name: WTC 1 V9D source-access dossier for NIST high-rate tensile channels and CF6-80A2 material evidence
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V9C, define a reproducible and complete request for the missing NIST room-temperature high-rate M26/C80 tensile channels, document the official access route without sending a request, and update the public CF6-80A2/Boeing 767 nacelle evidence audit without generic material substitution. No coupon, failure deletion, facade impact, whole-aircraft, global tower, thermal or Blender physics work is authorized.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: A statement or identifier transcribed from an identified official or manufacturer source.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A published NIST reduction or modelling result, not a new measurement by V9D.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: No local-archive claim is introduced and the source archive is not rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: A declared dossier-completeness rule; it is not a material-property assumption.
evidence_policy.derived_result: A deterministic completeness and provenance check over the declared source-access dossier.
evidence_policy.unknown: The content and release status of the requested NIST channels and the production CF6-80A2/nacelle material-fracture records.

report.title: Mechanical Properties of Structural Steels. Federal Building and Fire Safety Investigation of the World Trade Center Disaster

postal_address_lines: National Institute of Standards and Technology
official_access_route.official_instruction: A request may be submitted in writing by email or letter and should describe the requested records with as much detail as possible.

public_indexes_checked.finding: The archive describes public WTC reports, media and simulations; the exact specimen-channel searches did not expose the requested tensile records.
The WTC repository indexes NCSTAR reports and media but did not expose specimen-level M26/C80 raw measurement channels in the targeted search.
This machine-readable dataset is for high-temperature quasistatic WTC steel, not the required room-temperature high-rate measurements.

exact_queries_exhausted: site:nist.gov NCSTAR 1-3D high strain rate raw data
site:data.nist.gov WTC steel high strain rate tensile raw data
records_requested: Original machine-readable time channel for each declared specimen.
Original unfiltered load-channel record, including each piezoelectric load-washer channel if recorded separately.
Grip-end strain channel used for load-signal alignment.
Corrected load/stress and strain records used for the published curves and scalar properties.
Sampling rate, channel units, sign conventions, calibration factors and calibration records.
Per-specimen t1/t2 alignment windows, filters, smoothing, baseline correction and data-reduction code or worksheet.
Original specimen dimensions, cross-sectional area, gauge length, orientation, extraction location and test temperature.
Per-specimen elastic-modulus estimate, uncertainty budget, rejected/repeated test notes and any record-retention or release restriction metadata.

preferred_delivery.format: Native machine-readable files when available; otherwise CSV or TSV with a data dictionary.
preferred_delivery.partial_release: Release any segregable non-exempt portion and identify unavailable, destroyed, transferred or withheld records by category.
preferred_delivery.fee_commitment: No fee commitment is made by this local draft; request advance notice before any charge.

cf6_80a2_public_update.target: Production General Electric CF6-80A2 engine and Boeing 767 nacelle/cowling components applicable to the WTC 1 aircraft configuration.

direct_facts: The index identifies GEK 50460 as the CF6-80A/A2 Installation Manual, revision 2 dated 1983-09-01.
GE states that supplementary support manuals are available by contacting Fleet Support.
sources.limitation: The public index does not disclose component alloy/layup mapping, rate-dependent constitutive curves, fracture energy, localization length or attachment-failure data.

direct_facts: GE identifies the CF6-80A family as a Boeing 767 engine and publishes general dimensions and performance ranges.
sources.limitation: General dimensions and performance do not identify a production material or fracture card.

direct_facts: The directive explicitly includes the CF6-80A2 and references GE CF6-80A Service Bulletin 72-0869 for specified high-pressure-turbine disks.
sources.limitation: The directive does not publish a reusable high-rate material/fracture law or nacelle attachment dataset.

direct_facts: The report studies a lightweight sandwich shell wrapped with dry Kevlar for a CF6-size engine containment concept.
sources.limitation: A CF6-size research concept is not traceable to the production CF6-80A2 core/cowling or Boeing 767 attachments and cannot be substituted.

direct_facts: The record describes a later one-piece BMI/honeycomb inner-cowl research design and notes that existing hot-region nacelles used aluminum sandwich or skin-stringer construction.
sources.limitation: The research design is not identified as the production Boeing 767 CF6-80A2 nacelle and supplies no assignable high-rate joint/fracture dataset.
